title: Additional System Design Interview Questions
summary: Practice problems with reference links, no written solutions
body:
# Additional System Design Interview Questions > Common system design interview questions, with links to resources on how to solve each. These have **no written solutions** — only reference links. That makes them the best practice material once you've worked the [exercises with solutions](../exercises/system-design/README.md): design each one yourself using the [four-step framework](../study-guide/interview-approach.md) first, *then* read the references and diff your design against what the references describe. | Question | Reference(s) | |---|---| | Design a file sync service like Dropbox | [youtube.com](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PE4gwstWhmc) | | Design a search engine like Google | [queue.acm.org](http://queue.acm.org/detail.cfm?id=988407)
